prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one photorealistic main-category image for HEALTH FAUCETS for the X-TRAL bathroom catalogue website, landscape 4:3. Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match its premium warm beige travertine, rich vertical walnut wood, golden window daylight, editorial architectural photography, detailed realistic materials. Reference image 2 is the PRODUCT: preserve the actual CORA HF-270092 health faucet's polished silver chrome finish, round small perforated spray face, cylindrical handle, curved rear trigger and round chrome wall holder. Show that single health faucet mounted upright on a warm travertine bathroom wall as the dominant sharply focused hero, with a realistic flexible chrome hose descending in a graceful loop and connected to a small chrome wall supply valve. A partial softly blurred white toilet at the lower left gives context. Restrained wood slat accent and softly glowing daylight, elegant uncluttered composition. Product centered and comfortably within central 70 percent so it works in category-card crops. Keep chrome silver, not gold. No text, no category title, no logo, no watermark, no inset or collage. Match the existing category image's quality, warmth and luxurious atmosphere while accurately retaining the referenced product shape.

Use case: product-mockup. Create one photorealistic main-category image for SHOWER DRAINS SERIES for the X-TRAL bathroom catalogue website, landscape 4:3. Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: use the same warm beige travertine, walnut details, soft golden daylight, premium architectural photography and realistic luxury bathroom atmosphere. Reference image 2 is the PRODUCT: accurately preserve the polished stainless-steel SD-702702 linear shower drain with long narrow rectangular frame and repeated straight narrow transverse slots. Show one such linear drain installed perfectly flush in a warm beige honed stone shower floor, crisp and clearly readable as the main hero. Low three-quarter camera looking down toward the floor, drain positioned diagonally across the middle of the composition, entire drain visible with breathing room and suited to category-card cropping. A restrained clear shower-glass edge at far side, soft blur of walnut bathroom millwork and warm stone in background, subtle small realistic beads of moisture and a very light wet sheen near drain. Silver stainless steel stays silver with warm light reflections, no gold finish. Physically plausible installation and regular drain slot geometry. No person, no feet, no faucet dominating the image, no loose drain sitting on top of floor. No text, no logo, no watermark, no split panels. Match the existing category image's quality and colour grading.

Use case: product-mockup. Create one photorealistic main-category image for ADDONS for the X-TRAL bathroom catalogue website. Landscape 4:3. Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match the warm travertine stone, soft golden window light, rich walnut slat background, premium realistic editorial bathroom photography. Reference image 2 is the ACTUAL CATALOGUE PRODUCT RANGE, not a layout to copy. Create one cohesive elegant still-life of a carefully selected set of these plumbing add-on fittings on a beige travertine counter: one square chrome shower arm SA 241212 lying horizontally toward rear (rectangular straight section, threaded inlet at rear and small downward outlet at front); one chrome PROJECT angle cock AD 110090 standing at left with its round flange and small upright pin lever; one pop-up waste coupling AD 110056 standing upright at front right with polished round mushroom cap, gasket, and cylindrical threaded body; two chrome brass extension nipples AD 110010 of different short heights beside it; and one flat round CP flange FL 001001 resting on stone. All products must closely match their silhouettes in reference image 2. Keep realistic relative scale: arm about 30cm long, coupling about 10cm high, nipples about 3-5cm. Silver chrome materials with warm reflected light, physically credible threads and subtle contact shadows. Arrangement centered, uncluttered, fully inside frame, prominent readable product group occupying middle 70 percent. Shallow depth of field, softly blurred walnut wood and stone behind. No basin faucet, no soap dispenser, no shower head, no towels obscuring hardware. No text, no labels, no typography, no logo, no watermark, no grid or split panels. Match existing category images in warmth and visual quality.
